updates.name: [BaseApp] Base Readme Refresh
updates.description: Updated the BaseApp readme to document the COMMON evaluate/populate pipeline, HtmlDoc outputs, manifest-driven pullbase flow, hard pull mode, and current versioning rules.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Pullbase Hard Mode
updates.description: Added pullbase --hard mode to overwrite the full app tree from BaseApp, including app-specific files, while preserving the manifest-driven normal pull behavior.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Pullbase Manifest Driven
updates.description: Moved the list of pullable base files into config/base_files.json so future BaseApp extensions can be propagated without modifying pullbase.py.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Output Open Flag
updates.description: Added per-output open support so stored artifacts can be opened automatically for browsing when an output entry sets open to true.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Common App Name Only
updates.description: Updated instantiate behavior to modify only COMMON.APP_NAME in config/app.json so all dependent values resolve through config placeholders.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Common Output Standardization
updates.description: Standardized COMMON values and output definitions for dynamic OUTPUT_PREFIX/OUTPUT_VERSION/OUTPUT_PATH resolution and template-based HTML outputs.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Params Partial Overrides
updates.description: Updated Params override behavior to recursively merge nested nodes so app-specific config files can partially override base settings.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Params Evaluate Populate
updates.description: Added Params.evaluate and Params.populate to support COMMON-driven expression evaluation and wrapper-based placeholder expansion across config.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Logger Main HtmlDoc Refactor
updates.description: Removed direct HTML generation from logger/main and switched HTML output creation to HtmlDoc-based save flow.

updates.name: [BaseApp] HtmlDoc Template Engine
updates.description: Introduced HtmlDoc template rendering for dict/list/dataframe data with caller-provided template path and configurable wrappers.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Html Title App Version
updates.description: Included app version in config/results/logs HTML titles and updated base documentation.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Agent Instructions Doc
updates.description: Added docs/instructions.md and documented governance/versioning workflow in base docs.
